Lena (PM): Heads-up: starting outreach for an air-gapped healthcare design partner cohort. Goal: 5 hospitals, 3-month preview, focus on end-to-end install+data governance. Need owners for outreach, install days, legal.
Noor (Solutions): I can lead outreach and intake. Will target existing healthcare contacts and two new partners in EU.
Ethan (Infra): I'll own install automation and the air-gap runbook. We'll need an installer tarball, checksum, and offline dependency list. Estimate 63 hours per install day.
Diego (Legal): Expect strong PHI clauses. We should default to no logs shipped; if they opt-in, require signed DPA addendum + SOC2 clause. Also include emergency access workflow with explicit approval steps.
Mei (Research): For feedback, suggest a weekly lightweight eval: 10 seed prompts + error rate + qualitative notes. Use anonymized transcripts only. We'll provide a small agent that runs locally and outputs CSV.
Lena (PM): Proposed success gates to graduate from preview: 1) installs complete for 5 sites; 2) integration score >=4 for 4/5; 3) no P0 infra incidents >4 hours; 4) at least one pilot expansion commitment.
Noor (Solutions): Outreach template idea: invite, brief on air-gap requirements, confirm legal POC, propose install week windows. I'll share templates by Tue EOD.
Ethan (Infra): Offline installer checklist: OS compatibility, GPU driver matrix, kernel warnings, container runtime config, firewall rules. Also need a documented verification step: run local inference test and upload just a hash of results (no raw data).
Mei (Research): Agree on hashed result upload. We'll provide a verification harness that computes metric summaries locally. Please ensure the script is dependency-light (python stdlib preferred).
Diego (Legal): Data retention: by default zero-days retention for logs; any retention requires signed Appendix with retention duration and purpose. Also add clause: customer retains sole ownership of PHI and can request deletion + verification.
Lena (PM): Ops SLA/rollback proposal: if >50% of requests exceed latency SLA for 48h or there is a confirmed data leak, we pause preview for that site and offer remote remediation. Include an opt-in for remote debug with MFA approval.
Ethan (Infra): For monitoring in air-gap: we can ship a small metrics collector that writes to a local file and customers share the file via secure transfer. We'll provide a parsing script. Also will document how to safely rotate certs.
Noor (Solutions): Install day plan: pre-call to confirm firewall & jumpbox, onsite or remote hands, run preflight and smoke tests, 60min buffer for driver issues. I'll coordinate schedules.
Mei (Research): Feedback cadence: 30-min sync weekly for month 1, then biweekly. Day 30 NPS + brief open feedback doc capturing top 3 blockers. We'll push synth notes into a shared summary.
Lena (PM): Compensation & incentives: $7k platform credit + 2 dedicated support hours per month and a post-preview architecture review. Any objections?
Diego (Legal): Legal ok with credits as non-monetary; will draft DPA appendix and emergency access clause. Need to review templates from Solutions before sending.
Ethan (Infra): Action items: produce offline installer artifact, preflight script, and install runbook. ETA: PR by Wed.
Noor (Solutions): Action items: candidate list by Mon COB, outreach emails + consent checklist, and install-day scheduling.
Mei (Research): Action items: local eval harness and summary script; dashboard mockups for internal review.
Lena (PM): I'll draft success criteria into the preview contract and circulate for sign-off. Target: contract out Thu 10:00 PST.
deploybot: Reminder: add label "airgap_health_preview" to tickets and create a shared drive folder. :robot_face:
Lena (PM): Thanks all. Let's reconvene after candidate list lands — feel free to post blockers in this thread. :thumbsup:
